# `scikitplot.visualkeras`

## Install

```sh
pip install scikit-plots
```

The release on PyPI can be older than the version this skill was read from, and
can lack `scikitplot.visualkeras`. If `import scikitplot.visualkeras` fails
after installing it, the installed release predates the module: the [release
history on PyPI](https://pypi.org/project/scikit-plots/#history) lists each
release, and [pip's user guide](https://pip.pypa.io/en/stable/user_guide/)
explains upgrading.

## Before writing code

The API below was read from one version of the package. Check the version the
project has, and read a name's docstring and signature before calling it

python -c "import scikitplot; print(scikitplot.__version__)"

## Public API

Declared in `scikitplot.visualkeras.__all__`, in that order.

| Name | Kind | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| `SpacingDummyLayer` | class | A factory class for dynamically generating a dummy Keras layer with custom spacing. |
| `graph_view` | function | Generates an architectural visualization for a given linear Keras `Model` model (i.e., one input and output tensor for each layer) in graph style. |
| `layered_view` | function | Generates an architectural visualization for a given linear Keras `Model` model (i.e., one input and output tensor for each layer) in a layered style, which is particularly suitable for convolutional neural networks (CNNs). |

All names with signatures: [references/API.md](references/API.md).
